title: Credit a recognised check preceded only by a recorded environment assignment (pwsh $env:NAME='v'; or bash NAME=v) on the same line
outcome: A test or build line of the form `$env:NAME='value'; <recognised launcher command>` (pwsh) or `NAME=value <command>` (bash), run in the measured named root, is credited when every assignment is to an allowlisted, provenance-recorded variable (for example CARGO_TARGET_DIR). The host records each name and value in the check's provenance. Any other prefix stays compound and refused, with a refusal that names the env-prefix form and the supported alternative (for example `cargo --target-dir`).
acceptance: Credit a recognised check preceded only by a recorded environment assignment (pwsh $env:NAME='v'; or bash NAME=v) on the same line is done
